nonNegotiableLaunchRules: No public users until launch gate is open.
No production payment flow until PayFast sandbox and ITN evidence pass.
No candidate data writes outside PostgreSQL/Supabase Truth Vault.
No workflow execution without idempotency key, correlation ID, and audit evidence.
No secrets in git, chat, reports, screenshots, or package artifacts.
No branch launch from unprotected main.
No web route may shell out to local Windows PowerShell as a public API path.
No broad tenant-blind RLS policies for public production traffic.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Protect main branch and require validators
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: GitHub branch protection rule with required launch gate status check

requiredLaunchGates.title: Materialize backend API as deployable runtime
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: apps/api package/runtime entrypoint, health route, command route, workflow result route, read-model routes, and deploy command

requiredLaunchGates.title: Replace repository stubs with real PostgreSQL/Supabase persistence
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: DB integration tests proving evidence, idempotency, heartbeat, command log, workflow result, and audit writes
requiredLaunchGates.remainingConstraint: Run API against staging PostgreSQL/Supabase with KINGSMEN_TRUTH_VAULT_MODE=postgres and capture integration proof before public users.

requiredLaunchGates.title: Enforce scoped RLS and access boundary
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: RLS tests proving candidate/operator/founder/service role boundaries

requiredLaunchGates.title: Remove local PowerShell/Windows shell execution from public Next API routes
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: Web API routes call backend API/SDK only; no local psql.exe or C:\Kingsmen paths

requiredLaunchGates.title: PayFast sandbox and ITN verification evidence
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: sandbox success, cancel, return, failed payment, duplicate ITN, invalid signature, and replay tests

requiredLaunchGates.title: Email provider and urgent WhatsApp-only boundary
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: email send/receive logs, bounce handling, opt-out policy, WhatsApp urgent-only approval evidence

requiredLaunchGates.title: Backup and restore drill
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: restore drill report with RPO/RTO and verified sample records

requiredLaunchGates.title: Operational monitoring and incident SOP
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: health checks, logs, DLQ view, incident runbook, founder escalation path

requiredLaunchGates.title: Privacy, consent, refund, and candidate terms
requiredLaunchGates.evidenceRequired: published terms, privacy notice, POPIA consent, refund/payment terms

launchPhases.definitionOfDone: Protected main, launch gate script present, required status checks configured.

launchPhases.goal: Backend, web, DB, and internal control plane run against staging.
launchPhases.definitionOfDone: API health, command intake, workflow result intake, DB writes, and web reads pass.

launchPhases.goal: Founder/operator can process real test candidates manually with evidence.
launchPhases.definitionOfDone: 10 end-to-end candidate journeys completed without unsafe writes or missing evidence.

launchPhases.goal: Limited paid pilot under active founder supervision.
launchPhases.definitionOfDone: PayFast proof, support process, refund process, and backup/restore proof are complete.

launchPhases.goal: Open public acquisition with capped load.
launchPhases.definitionOfDone: All required launch gates pass and candidate cap is enforced.
